screenTitle: SMM Dashboard (Сервис SMM накрутки лайков, подписчиков и просмотров)
prompt:
Generate a high-fidelity Desktop SMM Dashboard screen based on "Сервис SMM накрутки лайков, подписчиков и просмотров | SMMPrime" (https://smmprime.ru).

Layout Architecture:
1. Fixed Left Sidebar (280px):
   - Brand Logo & Header with status chip
   - Multi-platform navigation sections: Услуги, Цены, Лайки, Подписчики, Комментарии, Просмотры, Репосты, Бесплатная накрутка
   - Real-time Balance Widget with "+ Add Funds" CTA button
   - User Profile info and settings gear icon

2. Top HUD Bar (64px):
   - Quick platform switcher pills
   - Search bar for instant service filtering
   - Notification bell and account balance badge

3. Main Canvas (Fluid 12-Column Grid):
   - Hero banner featuring hot service categories (Услуги, Цены, Лайки, Подписчики, Комментарии, Просмотры, Репосты, Бесплатная накрутка)
   - Multi-platform service grid with pricing per unit (e.g. 0.18 ₽ / unit)
   - Fast 4-step Order Wizard (1. Platform -> 2. Category -> 3. Service -> 4. Target Link & Quantity)
   - Live order stream / recent transactions summary table

Visual Aesthetics:
- Enterprise Clean B2B SaaS theme (Linear/Vercel aesthetic) with high-density data presentation, 280px left collapsible sidebar, HUD top navbar with instant wallet balance, fluid 12-column grid, and tabular data tables.
- Tailwind 4 @theme tokens: bg-card (#ffffff / #12161f in dark), border-border, text-foreground, high WCAG 2.2 AA contrast, 48px touch targets.
- Typography: Inter with tabular-nums for numeric rates and prices
